subject.title: ci: bump unified release workflow to alpha.12

question: Should this repository adopt the alpha.12 reusable release workflow for future releases that run with write-token permissions?
rationale: The caller diff is safe-looking, but the behavioral change resides in externally supplied reusable workflow code that was not available in the provided review context.

options.title: Verify alpha.12 and merge
options.body: Review the alpha.12 workflow changes for compatibility with this caller’s inputs and write permissions, then merge if its release behavior remains intended.

options.title: Hold at alpha.11
options.body: Keep the existing reference until the reusable workflow release is reviewed or a stable version is selected.

recommendation.title: Verify alpha.12 and merge
recommendation.body: Review the alpha.12 workflow changes for compatibility with this caller’s inputs and write permissions, then merge if its release behavior remains intended.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and author of this targeted workflow upgrade, steipete is best positioned to confirm the intended release-workflow adoption.
